mapper.sql: c.card_id, c.card_type, c.card_name, c.card_status, c.pass_type, c.issue_reason, c.remark, c.person_id, c.biostar_card_id, c.biostar_card_value, c.use_yn, c.del_yn, c.reg_dt, c.mod_dt, CONVERT(varchar(10), c.fee_paid_dt, 23) AS fee_paid_dt, CONVERT(varchar(10), c.issue_dt, 23) AS issue_dt, CONVERT(varchar(10), c.lost_dt, 23) AS lost_dt, CONVERT(varchar(10), c.return_dt, 23) AS return_dt, cdt.code_name AS card_type_name, cs.code_name AS card_status_name, pt.code_name AS pass_type_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_card c LEFT JOIN tb_common cdt ON cdt.cmm_id = 'CDT' AND cdt.code_id = c.card_type LEFT JOIN tb_common cs ON cs.cmm_id = 'CS' AND cs.code_id = c.card_status LEFT JOIN tb_common pt ON pt.cmm_id = 'PT' AND pt.code_id = c.pass_type WHERE c.del_yn = 'N' AND c.person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY c.card_id

SELECT FROM tb_card c LEFT JOIN tb_common cdt ON cdt.cmm_id = 'CDT' AND cdt.code_id = c.card_type LEFT JOIN tb_common cs ON cs.cmm_id = 'CS' AND cs.code_id = c.card_status LEFT JOIN tb_common pt ON pt.cmm_id = 'PT' AND pt.code_id = c.pass_type WHERE c.del_yn = 'N' AND c.biostar_card_value = #{cardNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_card (card_type, card_name, card_status, pass_type, fee_paid_dt, issue_dt, issue_reason, remark, person_id, biostar_card_id, biostar_card_value) VALUES (#{cardType}, #{cardName}, #{cardStatus}, #{passType}, #{feePaidDt}, getdate(), #{issueReason}, #{remark}, #{personId}, #{biostarCardId}, #{biostarCardValue})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_card SET person_id = #{personId}, use_yn = 'Y', del_yn = 'N', card_type = #{cardType}, card_name = #{cardName}, card_status = #{cardStatus}, pass_type = #{passType}, fee_paid_dt = #{feePaidDt}, issue_reason = #{issueReason}, remark = #{remark}, mod_dt = getdate() WHERE card_id = #{cardId}
UPDATE tb_card SET person_id = NULL, use_yn = 'Y', del_yn = 'N', mod_dt = getdate() WHERE person_id = #{personId} AND del_yn = 'N'
